title: Case Analysis Method & Discovery — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes the Systematic Case Study Discovery Framework: extracting business drivers, non-functional requirements, technical constraints, and mapping them directly to Google Cloud target architectures.
routing_rationale: PCA case study analysis requires decoupling subjective narrative from objective architectural constraints: identify compliance, latency, cost, and availability requirements first before selecting GCP services.

nodes.label: Business Driver: Global Expansion
nodes.detail: Company expanding from US to Europe and Asia; demands 99.99% availability.

nodes.label: Regulatory Constraint: HIPAA/GDPR
nodes.detail: Patient and customer data must remain encrypted at rest and in transit with audit logs.

nodes.label: Constraint Matrix Evaluator
nodes.detail: Evaluates candidate architectures; rejects single-region solutions due to global latency.

nodes.label: Target Cloud Architecture
nodes.detail: Global Anycast External ALB + Regional GKE + Cloud Spanner Multi-Region.

nodes.label: FinOps Cost Model Sign-off
nodes.detail: Confirms solution meets budget ceiling using 3-year Flexible Spend CUDs.

steps.title: Constraint Extraction
steps.action: Architect deconstructs case study text into numeric SLAs, latency targets, and compliance rules.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents subjective architectural bias by anchoring on quantitative requirements.

steps.title: Architecture Blueprint Synthesis
steps.action: Matches requirements to GCP multi-region topology and confirms financial sustainability.
steps.why_traversal: Produces exam-winning designs that satisfy both technical and commercial criteria.

scenarios.label: Over-Engineering Distractor Trap
scenarios.root_cause: Architect proposed complex real-time Apache Beam pipeline when requirements only asked for daily batch reports.
scenarios.diverted_path: Operational overhead and cost exceed project scope by 400%.
scenarios.recovery: Adhere strictly to minimal operational complexity: use BigQuery scheduled queries for batch reporting.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Visualizes the Systematic Case Study Discovery Framework: extracting business drivers, non-functional requirements, technical constraints, and mapping them directly to Google Cloud target architectures.
